description: HeatpumpMonitor is an open-source website for sharing and comparing heat-pump performance records. The provider repository describes a public list of systems that send measurements through emoncms and includes deployment instructions for the website. Users can inspect monitored heat pump operation and compare performance across participating systems; the site's scope depends on voluntarily shared installations. GitHub metadata states AGPL-3.0 terms for the site code. A limitation is that volunteer systems may differ in metering setup, climate, building fabric and operating choices, so comparisons do not isolate equipment efficiency. The source code is reusable, but this metadata review did not independently verify the current hosted site's complete data export or API terms. HeatpumpMonitor can supply empirical context for building heat-demand and district-energy simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis is a weather dataset, not measured heat-pump performance. No meter data or website archive was downloaded.
name: HeatpumpMonitor public performance portal
notes: G7 G7-1653. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Hosted data export was not checked; draft covers the public repository and documented performance-sharing portal.
